name: ai-seo
description: Check whether AI answers in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews mention your brand, and in Claude Code create llms.txt and add AI crawler rules to robots.txt in your project, showing the diff before each change. Uses answers you paste or log to show how often you appear, how your business is described and which sources get cited instead. Builds a repeatable prompt panel you run yourself, turns the AI answers you saved month to month into an AI visibility scorecard you can send as a client report, analyzes citation exports, and checks one page to tell you what to change so ChatGPT or Perplexity can quote it accurately. Contains no code of its own and stores nothing.
